rules.name: bom
rules.summary: Remove a UTF-8 BOM from the start of the file.

rules.name: line-endings
rules.summary: Normalize CRLF/CR line endings to LF.

rules.name: final-newline
rules.summary: End the file with exactly one newline.

rules.name: trailing-whitespace
rules.summary: Remove trailing whitespace, preserving two-space hard breaks.

rules.name: multiple-blank-lines
rules.summary: Collapse two or more blank lines to one.

rules.name: leading-blank-lines
rules.summary: Remove blank lines before the first block.

rules.name: hard-tab
rules.summary: Avoid tab characters in prose and indentation.

rules.name: non-breaking-space
rules.summary: Replace NBSP (U+00A0) with a normal space outside code.

rules.name: zero-width-character
rules.summary: Detect stray zero-width spaces and mid-file BOMs.

rules.name: atx-missing-space
rules.summary: Add a space after the ATX heading marker (#).

rules.name: atx-multiple-space
rules.summary: Use one space after the ATX heading marker.

rules.name: atx-closing-hashes
rules.summary: Remove optional closing hashes from an ATX heading.

rules.name: heading-blank-lines
rules.summary: Separate top-level headings from surrounding paragraphs with blank lines.

rules.name: heading-indent
rules.summary: Verify indented headings are intentional (for example, inside a list).

rules.name: heading-increment
rules.summary: Do not skip heading levels.

rules.name: empty-heading
rules.summary: Remove or fill an empty heading.

rules.name: heading-trailing-punctuation
rules.summary: Avoid ending headings with sentence punctuation.

rules.name: first-heading-h1
rules.summary: Start the document outline with an H1.

rules.name: multiple-h1
rules.summary: Prefer one H1 per document; repeated H1s are sometimes intentional in changelogs and task logs.

rules.name: blockquote-space
rules.summary: Put one space after each blockquote marker.

rules.name: list-marker-space
rules.summary: Add a space between a list marker and its content.

rules.name: list-marker-style
rules.summary: Use one bullet marker per list; a different marker starts a new list, so this is reported, not fixed.

rules.name: list-blank-lines
rules.summary: Separate lists from surrounding paragraphs with blank lines.

rules.name: empty-list-item
rules.summary: Remove empty list items or give them content.

rules.name: emphasis-inner-space
rules.summary: Remove spaces just inside emphasis delimiters.

rules.name: unmatched-emphasis
rules.summary: Check for a possible unmatched strong or strikethrough delimiter.

rules.name: cjk-emphasis-unpaired
rules.summary: Report ** or * that cannot pair next to CJK or full-width punctuation; move closing-side punctuation outside when safe.

rules.name: fence-language
rules.summary: Add a language to fenced code blocks when one is known.

rules.name: fence-unclosed
rules.summary: Close every fenced code block.

rules.name: fence-blank-lines
rules.summary: Surround top-level fenced code blocks with blank lines.

rules.name: fence-invalid
rules.summary: Use a valid fence info string.

rules.name: table-delimiter-width
rules.summary: Use at least three hyphens in each table delimiter cell.

rules.name: table-column-count
rules.summary: Keep the same number of cells in every table row.

rules.name: table-blank-lines
rules.summary: Surround top-level tables with blank lines.

rules.name: table-pipe-in-code
rules.summary: Escape pipes inside code spans or URLs in table cells.

rules.name: bare-url
rules.summary: Prefer an explicit link or angle-bracket autolink for bare URLs.

rules.name: empty-link
rules.summary: Give links meaningful text and a destination.

rules.name: link-space-before-destination
rules.summary: A space between ] and ( prevents link parsing.

rules.name: reference-missing-definition
rules.summary: Define every explicit reference-link label.

rules.name: reference-duplicate-definition
rules.summary: Define each reference-link label once.

rules.name: image-alt
rules.summary: Add image alt text or confirm the image is decorative.

rules.name: setext-ambiguity
rules.summary: A line of --- or === after a paragraph is a Setext heading, not a rule.

rules.name: frontmatter-unclosed
rules.summary: Close YAML frontmatter with --- or ... .

rules.name: frontmatter-blank-line
rules.summary: Put a blank line after frontmatter.

rules.name: html-comment-unclosed
rules.summary: Close every HTML comment.

rules.name: fullwidth-markdown-syntax
rules.summary: Use ASCII punctuation for Markdown syntax.

rules.name: math-unclosed
rules.summary: Close every $$ math block.

rules.name: resource-limit
rules.summary: Keep blockquote nesting within the configured depth limit (maxQuoteDepth).

rules.name: line-length
rules.summary: Keep prose lines within the configured limit.
